title: Rename Limatus to Humanus
description:
Rename the project from Limatus to Humanus everywhere.

Scope:
- GitHub: rename AnthusAI/Limatus to AnthusAI/Humanus (GitHub keeps redirects from the old URL).
- Python package: rename the import package limatus to humanus, the CLI entry point limatus to humanus, and the distribution to humanus. PyPI cannot rename a project, so publish humanus as a new project (free as of 2026-10-20) and ship a final limatus release that depends on humanus and re-exports it, with a deprecation notice. Re-point the PyPI trusted publisher at the renamed repo.
- npm: Limatus is not published on npm, so nothing to rename there.
- Docs, README, SKILL.md, schema $id URLs, wiki, semantic-release config, .kanbus.yml project key if it is name-derived.
- Downstream: Papyrus (pyproject pin, editorial-checks Lambda requirements, imports in papyrus_content, docs), Threat-Intelligence and any other AnthusAI project that references limatus.

Sequencing: start after the standard rule sets work (feat/standard-rule-sets) merges, because the rename touches every module.

Done when: pip install humanus works, humanus check runs, Papyrus develop installs humanus and its specs pass, and no AnthusAI repo still imports limatus.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope addition (requested 2026-10-20): change the Kanbus project key from LIM to HUM. Existing issues need re-keying (LIM-xxxx to HUM-xxxx) or the board needs to resolve both prefixes, so do this together with the repo rename. Also update references to LIM- ids in docs, wiki and memory notes, and the linked Papyrus issues that point at LIM ids.
